mapper.select: SELECT os.id, os.order_id, o.order_no, o.create_time AS order_create_time, o.pay_status, o.pay_amount, os.delivery_status, os.shipping_name, os.shipping_no, os.shipping_time, os.total_amount AS shipment_amount, o.user_id, u.username, u.phone, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, oi.id AS item_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.product_image, oi.price, oi.quantity, (oi.price * oi.quantity) AS item_total FROM order_shipment os INNER JOIN `order` o ON os.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN order_item oi ON oi.shipment_id = os.id WHERE os.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY os.create_time DESC

SELECT os.id, os.order_id, o.order_no, o.create_time AS order_create_time, o.pay_status, o.pay_amount, os.delivery_status, os.shipping_name, os.shipping_no, os.shipping_time, os.total_amount AS shipment_amount, o.user_id, u.username, u.phone, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, oi.id AS item_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.product_image, oi.price, oi.quantity, (oi.price * oi.quantity) AS item_total FROM order_shipment os INNER JOIN `order` o ON os.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN order_item oi ON oi.shipment_id = os.id WHERE os.order_id = #{orderId} AND os.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY os.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE order_shipment SET delivery_status = 1, shipping_name = #{shippingName}, shipping_no = #{shippingNo}, shipping_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{shipmentId} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND delivery_status = 0
